technology_name: Bio-Filler Epoxy Composite with High Wear Resistance and Strength
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard petroleum-derived epoxy resins exhibit poor sustainability profiles, low impact strengths, and accelerate mechanical wear under structural friction.
description: A synthetic formulation method utilizing microcrystalline cellulose based bio-fillers to reinforce a epoxidized seed oil epoxy array, improving overall tensile strength by up to 55% and impact resistance by 10% to 20%.
applications: Automotive interior body moldings, structural eco-adhesives, sustainable consumer goods packaging, and high-wear industrial machinery components.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Consumer & Lifestyle Products Engineering
